title: Pure Phase-A WOFOST Prepare-Assimilation Provider
goal: Implement and qualify the source-bound read-only phase-A provider that produces actual PGASS for the restricted standard-WOFOST profile from a semantic crop state view, shared immutable rate parameters, candidate-local TMNR and explicit solar/weather/CO2 forcing.
reference_numeric_rules: preserve B1.10 three-point Gauss coordinates and weights for time and canopy-depth integration
preserve B1.10 PI literal after real64 rounding
preserve source arithmetic ordering where it affects reference floating-point behavior

explicit_global_removal.legacy_running_Tmin_state_update: remains F-WOF26 candidate-local preparation; provider receives TMNR only

fail_closed_rules: all used state, parameter-table results and forcing values must be finite
RAD and DIFPP must be nonnegative
FCO2EFF and FCO2AMAX must be nonnegative
if AMAX<=0 or LAI<=0, DTGA is exactly zero and unused solar denominator checks are skipped
if RAD=0 on an otherwise active path, DTGA is exactly zero
when active irradiation is evaluated require DSINBE>0 and positive SINB at every Gauss time point before division
when direct-beam VISPP>0 require effective EFFC>0 before division by EFFC*VISPP

new_source_bound_discrepancy.finding: B1.10 read_wofost admits EFF=0, while ASSIM divides by EFF*VISPP whenever VISPP>0; the exact zero-efficiency direct-beam case is therefore not numerically defined by the legacy implementation.
new_source_bound_discrepancy.disposition: fail closed for active direct-beam evaluation with effective EFFC<=0; do not invent a limiting formula in this work unit
